entities.summary: Jacob Larsson is a Swedish professional ice hockey defenseman currently playing with the SC Rapperswil-Jona Lakers of the National League (NL). He was selected by the Anaheim Ducks of the National Hockey League (NHL) 27th overall in the 2015 NHL entry draft. He has also played for the Ottawa Senators in the NHL and Frölunda HC of the Swedish Hockey League.
